name: Itzpapa
description:
After your characters take DMG: Deduct 1 Nightsoul point from Citlali and create 1 stack of Opal Shield.
When Citlali gains Nightsoul points and her Nightsoul points reach 2, prioritize dealing 1 Cryo DMG to the opponent's active character.
Duration (Rounds): 2
